useCases.title: for every one
useCases.heading: Whoever you are, your data should work for you
useCases.description: polar.is is built for every kind of athlete — from weekend warriors to elite coaches.

runner.label: for the runner
runner.title: "Should I run today?"
runner.description: One number. One answer. Your readiness score tells you if your body is primed for intervals, steady state, or rest. No more guessing after a bad night's sleep.

triathlete.label: for the triathlete
triathlete.title: "Am I overreaching across three sports?"
triathlete.description: Training load stacked across swim, bike, and run. Spot cumulative fatigue before it becomes injury. Know when to swap a brick session for recovery.

strength.label: for the strength athlete
strength.title: "Is my CNS recovered?"
strength.description: HRV and ANS charge reveal autonomic recovery — the missing piece for knowing when to lift heavy again. Stop leaving gains on the table from under-recovery.

coach.label: for the coach
coach.title: "How's my squad looking this morning?"
coach.description: See every athlete's readiness at a glance. Green = go, yellow = moderate, red = rest. No spreadsheets required. Spot overreaching before it becomes injury.

curious.label: for the curious
curious.title: "What does my watch actually know about me?"
curious.description: Turn raw Polar data into stories. Sleep architecture, fitness fingerprints, recovery debt — finally visualized.

mums.label: for moms
mums.title: "When did I last sleep properly?"
mums.description: Track sleep debt across broken nights. See your recovery trend, not just last night's score. Know when your body is asking for rest.

shiftWorkers.label: for shift workers
shiftWorkers.title: "Is my body coping with nights?"
shiftWorkers.description: See how night shifts wreck your recovery in real data. Track HRV decline, sleep quality collapse, and cumulative fatigue.

privacyModal.title: Privacy Notice
privacyModal.whatDataText: We access your Polar Flow data (sleep, heart rate, activity, recovery) via the Polar AccessLink API to display your personal dashboard.
privacyModal.legalBasisText: GDPR Article 6(1)(a) — your consent. You can withdraw it anytime by deleting your data.
privacyModal.storageText: Your session token is stored encrypted in Cloudflare KV for 30 days. We do not store your raw health data permanently.
privacyModal.sharingText: We do not sell, share, or transfer your data to any third party. Ever.
privacyModal.rightsText: Access, rectification, erasure, portability, and restriction. Delete everything with the "Delete Data" button at any time.
privacyModal.retentionText: Data is deleted automatically after 30 days of inactivity, or immediately when you click "Delete Data".
privacyModal.contactText: For privacy questions, contact us through the dashboard.

noData.title: No data found
noData.description: Your Polar account doesn't have data for the selected period. Sync your watch with the Polar Flow app — open the app on your phone, pull down to refresh, and wait for the sync to complete.
